model_spec_hy4_fixture.json: a two-entry catalog (hy4_preview_b4, hy4_preview_b8) for the CPU tests of scripts/hy4_agentx.
Built once from the output of models/demos/blackhole/hy4_preview/catalog/gen_hy4_spec.py (branch ssinghal/hy4-preview-dims, commit 419f6747e89, D3-1 contract) on top of the structure of the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash release
entry (release/dsv41_flash_img5/model_spec.json). Only the fields the client side reads matter (model_id, impl, max_concurrency, max_context, max_tokens_all_users_override, vllm_args);
every other value is UNVERIFIED and is replaced by the real catalog at release time (the golden specs in tests/fixtures/hy4/golden are regenerated by `HY4_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 pytest tests/test_hy4_harness.py`).
